content_sections.heading: About SNDTWU
content_sections.text: SNDT Women's University is based in Mumbai. This notice is for the University Department of Psychology at its Churchgate Campus, and the vacancy is for an unaided teaching post purely on a temporary basis, only for the academic year 2026-2027.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice says the number of posts advertised may increase or decrease depending on the vacancies available at the time of the interview.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates from all categories can apply for the open post. For the discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.qualification: M.A. (Psychology), regular full-time mode, with NET/SET or with PhD in Psychology; a Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade) in Psychology from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: fixed monthly remuneration of up to Rs. 52000/- per month for the academic year 2026-2027. The appointment is purely temporary and strictly only for the academic year 2026-2027. A selected person has no enforceable right against the University to continuation in the succeeding academic session under any circumstances. A selected person may avail only applicable Casual leave during the academic session. No other leave and allowances are permitted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SNDTWU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants are requested to apply on plain paper addressing the Head, Department of Psychology, along with a mark list and degree and experience certificates. They must be present for the walk-in interview at the Department of Psychology, 5th floor, Annex Building, SNDT Women's University, 1, N.T. Road, New Marine Lines, Mumbai - 400020, with all relevant documents, on 25 November 2026 at 11:30 am. The application and CV should mention a valid e-mail and a working mobile number. For genuine concerns, the notice gives the email address [email protected] . Candidates attend at their own expense; no TA/DA will be provided.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Mark list, degree certificate and experience certificate. Photocopies of all relevant certificates; self-attested copies are to be attached in support of the information given, and all information must be substantiated by supporting documents. All original documents of credentials, to be produced at the time of the interview. A "No Objection Certificate" from the present employer at the time of the interview, if working in a University department / institution or affiliated college.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates should satisfy themselves that they are eligible in all respects before applying; no inquiry asking for advice on eligibility will be entertained. Candidates must give information on pending court cases, criminal cases and disciplinary actions, if any. Any change after submission, until the recruitment process ends, must be brought to the University's notice, failing which the University reserves the right to cancel the candidature and debar the candidate from all selections. Incomplete applications, applications without required enclosures and applications not submitted in the prescribed manner will be summarily rejected. If any information is found false, incomplete or incorrect, the candidature/appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated. The University is not responsible for postponement or cancellation of scheduled interviews for unforeseen or unavoidable reasons. No correspondence will be made with applicants who are not short-listed. Canvassing, direct or indirect, in any form throughout the selection process entails disqualification. The notice ends with a declaration, to be signed by the candidate with date and name, that all instructions and terms and conditions are read and accepted.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SNDTWU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for Assistant Professor (Unaided) (Temporary- Fulltime) in the Department of Psychology, open category.

faq.question: Q2. When is the SNDTWU walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026 at 11:30 am at the Department of Psychology, 5th floor, Annex Building, SNDT Women's University, 1, N.T. Road, New Marine Lines, Mumbai - 400020.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for SNDTWU Assistant Professor Psychology?
faq.answer: M.A. (Psychology), regular full-time mode, with NET/SET or with PhD in Psychology, and a Master's degree with 55% marks in Psychology. Minimum 5 years' experience is listed.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the SNDTWU Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The post carries fixed monthly remuneration of up to Rs. 52000/- per month for the academic year 2026-2027.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for SNDTWU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply on plain paper addressed to the Head, Department of Psychology, with a mark list and degree and experience certificates, and be present at the walk-in interview with all relevant documents.

faq.question: Q6. Is the SNDTWU Assistant Professor job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary and only for the academic year 2026-2027, with no enforceable right to continuation in the next academic session.

faq.question: Q7. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. Candidates attend at their own expense and no TA/DA will be provided.

faq.question: Q8. Is a No Objection Certificate required?
faq.answer: Yes, if the candidate is working in a University department, institution or affiliated college; the NOC from the present employer is produced at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is knowledge of Marathi required?
faq.answer: Knowledge of / proficiency in the Marathi language will be preferred, as per the notice.
